newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * President Emil Constantinescu attended a meeting of Romania's Supreme Defence Council which discussed a project for national security and military strategy.
* The Lower Chamber of Deputies rejected on Thursday an opposition motion accusing the new centrist government of mishandling agrarian policies.

* A delegation of Council of Europe monitors, on a last review mission to Romania, met representatives of the ethnic Hungarian minority, whose leaders said they agreed that the Council of Europe should end monitoring of Romania.
* The European monitors will meet Justice Minister Valeriu Stoica later on Thursday.
* The troubles facing two Romanian banks are an exception, proving that the local banking system is growing healthier, Constantinescu told a conference with potential foreign investors.
* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea met representatives of Canada's Atomic Energy Ltd to discuss projects at Romania's nuclear energy plant in Cernavoda.
The Canadians are negotiating with Renel state electricity authority on a project to build a second nuclear reactor at Cernavoda.
